🎥🎬: Fightland

Fightland pulls viewers into the ruthless world of professional boxing, where talented fighters battle for recognition while promoters, trainers, and power players compete for control behind the scenes. Every opportunity comes with a price, and one decision can turn an unknown fighter into a star—or destroy everything they’ve worked for.

Outside the ring, shifting alliances, personal rivalries, and hidden agendas make the fight for success even more dangerous. As the pressure builds, the characters discover that surviving the business can be tougher than surviving a championship bout.

source_details.synopsis: Fightland is a boxing crime drama television series created by Daniel Fajemisin-Duncan, Marlon Smith, Damione Macedon and Raphael Jackson Jr.. It premiered on July 31, 2026, on Starz in the United States and August 27, 2026, on Sky Atlantic in the United Kingdom.
